instruction: Take a 1920x1080 screenshot of the video player and save it as 'screenshot.png' on the Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires capturing a full HD screenshot (1920x1080) from VLC. Evaluator verifies that the saved image has exactly these dimensions. The video is played at 1920x1080 resolution, so a proper screenshot should maintain these dimensions. Verified from gold image: width=1920, height=1080.
